description: Ministry of  Foreign Affairs - Regulations of the United Nations (Sanctions relating to proliferation of Nuclear, Chemical or Biological Weapons  2017
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs under the United Nations Act, establishing legal prohibitions and penalties related to the proliferation of nuclear, chemical, and biological weapons. It creates new legal obligations, defines offenses, and specifies punishments, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural announcement.
